title: Input segment of the configuration code
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. For every natural number $i<n$, the bit of the configuration code at position $i$ (taking the default value false if that position is out of range) equals the $i$-th bit of $x$, again defaulting to false if $i$ is beyond the end of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
